answers.solution:
I've diagnosed the problem against the real `coding-hermes/boardctl` repository (cloned to `/tmp/boardctl`, HEAD includes fix `1b80e79`), and verified the solution. The write-up is at:

**`/home/kara/go-jsonl-board-stale-topology-b-error-solution.md`**

## Summary of the diagnosis & fix

**Root cause 1 — no `init`:** `Resolve()` only *located* boards; nothing ever created the `tasks.jsonl`/`events.jsonl`/`board.jsonl` trilogy, so fresh projects always hit `no JSONL foreman board found`.

**Root cause 2 — stale DuckDB error text:** The JSONL cutover (2026-09-03) deleted `board.db` and `scripts/`, but several paths still said *"header lives in board.db (DuckDB cache) — use scripts/update header manually"*. In reality a board without `board.jsonl` is legacy **topology B** (header = line 1 of `tasks.jsonl`). That text misdirected users to files that no longer exist.

**Root cause 3 — mirror-from-last on empty:** `Create()` deep-copied the last task row to learn the schema, and aborted when `tasks.jsonl` was empty (`no row to mirror ... cannot create`).

**Fix (commit `1b80e79`, 8 files):** added `boardctl init [-C dir] [--project P] [--namespace NS]` writing the three topology-A files idempotently (no-clobber, re-run exits 0 "already initialized"); made `create` build the first row from a built-in `DefaultTaskRowKeys` fleet schema on empty `tasks.jsonl`; corrected all topology-B error text to the real read-only message with a migration path; added `init.go`, `init_test.go`, `main_test.go` cases; updated the README.

**Verified:**
- `strings bin/boardctl | grep -iE 'board\.db|scripts/update'` → 0 matches (the pre-fix binary has several)
- `go test ./...` → both packages **ok**
- Fresh-dir smoke: `init` → `create T-1` (30-key fleet schema emitted) → `stats` → re-`init` "already initialized", all exit 0
- Topology-B board correctly refused with the corrected migration text
- Judge `PASS 4ca4936b` per the repo's own `.gitreins` records

The document is self-contained (root causes, exact code/commands, verification) and is ready to use.

signatures.description: boardctl (coding-hermes/boardctl) fresh-project bootstrap was impossible: create failed on every empty-board state. Root cause 1: no init subcommand existed to write the three JSONL board files (tasks.jsonl, events.jsonl, board.jsonl header) - create exited 1 with 'no JSONL foreman board found'. Root cause 2: after hand-making empty tasks.jsonl+events.jsonl, the board was misdetected as legacy topology B (header on line 1 of tasks.jsonl) and every write path failed with 'header lives in board.db (DuckDB cache) - use scripts/update header manually' - a stale message from the removed DuckDB cache era: board.db and scripts/ dir no longer exist in the repo (JSONL cutover 2026-09-03). Root cause 3: header-only board.jsonl + empty tasks.jsonl failed 'tasks.jsonl is empty - no row to mirror the schema from; cannot create' because create mirrored the row schema from the last task row instead of a built-in default. Fix: add boardctl init [-C dir] [--project P --namespace NS] writing the three topology-A files idempotently (no-clobber; re-run exits 0 'already initialized'); create on empty tasks.jsonl now builds rows from a built-in default schema (DefaultTaskRowKeys with standard fleet fields); topology-B error text corrected to 'topology B is read-only; migrate by splitting line 1 of tasks.jsonl into board.jsonl'. Verified: 0 occurrences of board.db|scripts/update in the built binary strings; init/create/stats/re-init smoke tests pass in a fresh dir; judge PASS (verdict 4ca4936b), commit 1b80e79.
